freeze_stage: After inspection of public source changes; before running the bounded experiment. This is a local prospective protocol, not external preregistration.
question: Can a sufficient retained observation of an actual published purchase-software guard become insufficient for evaluating that guard under its revised rule?

source.license: GPL-3.0 (upstream license.txt preserved alongside complete source files)

selection.included: One small published change with a directly executable changed method and upstream regression case. Both changed guard versions are pinned by full commit identifiers.
selection.candidate_not_experiment: PR 58177 adds a wider exchange-rate validation path; its archived metadata and patch document candidate screening only. It is not a second evaluated change.
selection.sampling: Convenience case selected after reading the two proposed public changes, not a representative sample of ERPNext maintenance changes.

bounded_domain.fixed_context: A Purchase Receipt with one item linked to one existing Purchase Order and one nonempty purchase_order_item; update_ordered_qty is a recorded no-op. Other validation, database transactions, ledger effects, access control and workflow reachability are outside the experiment.
bounded_domain.status_justification: To Bill is an actual Purchase Order status used in the upstream reproduction. Closed and Cancelled are the two status literals in the changed method. This selected Cartesian domain is bounded; no field-distribution or deployment-prevalence inference is made.
bounded_domain.before_predicate: guard passes iff status is neither Closed nor Cancelled
bounded_domain.after_predicate: guard passes iff status is not Cancelled and (status is not Closed or is_return)
bounded_domain.receipt_construction: Construct one candidate per complete state and policy; retain the old Boolean and selected fields, then admit only observations sufficient over the declared domain. These are synthetic receipts, not exported ERPNext decision logs.
bounded_domain.historical_interpretation: Reuse or impact assessment under the new rule. The experiment does not revoke a historically valid old decision and does not establish a production need to apply this change retroactively.

execution.model: New local two-block adapter reuses the existing generic FiniteDiagnostics implementation, with independently authored declarative predicates. Existing BPI models and all three-engine timings remain unchanged.
execution.source_reference: Compile and execute the complete unmodified method AST from each archived upstream version under explicit mocks for frappe.get_lazy_doc, frappe.throw, frappe.bold, translation, document get, and purchase-order update_ordered_qty. Never supply model labels to this source execution.
execution.reference_diagnostics: Exhaustively classify every projection and both claimed old Boolean values using source-executed labels; derive all minimal robust query sets by pairwise opposed-completion separation and verify model witnesses separately.
execution.upstream_tests: Replay the changed-guard inputs corresponding to the upstream closed-return and ordinary-receipt checks. Archive the full upstream regression source; do not claim that its complete Frappe integration test was executed.
execution.offline_reproduction: Main analysis reads archived, hashed sources and performs no network access.

outputs: observation_audit.jsonl with all admitted and rejected queries
retention_ledger.jsonl with both constructed retention policies
summary.json with all safe/stale/insufficient/invalid counts and source/model agreement
manuscript_insert.txt and table.md with explicit boundaries
acceptance_checks: Commit parent relation and unchanged source method extraction verified
Every selected complete input agrees between source execution and declared predicates
Every partial-input query agrees between FiniteDiagnostics and source-executed pairwise reference
Reported opposed completions preserve retained fields and have opposite source outcomes
Full-information negative control has no insufficient receipt
Invalid old claims are rejected before interpreting the new result
All outcomes, including no-effect observations, are retained
